name: GRS Obkhod-Shakhunya Gas Pipeline

values.OtherLanguagePrimaryPipelineName: Межпоселковый газопровод высокого давления от ГРС в районе д. Обход до г. Шахунья

researcher_notes: NEW ROW (built, operating): 30.6 km high-pressure inter-settlement gas pipeline from the GRS near Obkhod village (Urensky municipal okrug) to Shakhunya, Nizhny Novgorod Oblast. Governor Nikitin reported completion to Putin by video link on 2026-09-18 (Gazprom + Gazprom mezhregiongaz + Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Nizhny Novgorod head Morozov present); newsroom24 reports gas started flowing 23 Sep 2026. Length 30.6 km = regional government release (niann/vremyan/pravda-nn all trace to it, one lineage); Prime (federal agency, independent report of the same event) confirms 'high-pressure' and endpoints. ONE ROW OR TWO: TWO. Jan 2026 ministry figures (niann 632796, vz-nn 76287) and the Dec 2024 Morozov statement (gipernn) list the 30 km 'gas pipeline-branch + GRS at Obkhod' (100% ready, GRS 54% in Jan 2026) separately from the 32 km 'GRS Obkhod -> Shakhunya' line (59.2%). The 30.6 km completed in Sep 2026 is the second (32 km planned, 30.6 built, described as 'from the GRS near Obkhod to Shakhunya'), so it is NOT the 30 km branch. The branch to GRS Obkhod (30 km, >=25 km, sourced, evidently operating since gas reached the GRS) is a separate candidate: start/trunk tie-in not found in sources, owner not confirmed (likely Gazprom/Gazprom transgaz Nizhny Novgorod) - recommend vetting as its own row; not staged here. Sibling follow-ons: Shakhunya-Tonshaevo 32.1 km (38.4%), Obkhod-Tonkino 31 km (39.7%), Obkhod-Vetluga etc. are under construction (Tonkino-Sharanga 24.5 km <25 km, excluded by length rule); Uren-Vetluga 78 km and Vetluzhsky-Varnavino 116 km also candidates (separate). Not matched to any existing row: GGIT working CSV has no Shakhunya/Obkhod/Urensk/Tonkino rows; no Nizhny Novgorod Oblast row with these endpoints (Gorky-* trunks are unrelated). Same class as P3973/P3974 (distribution, Gazprom PJSC owner). Owner: Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Nizhny Novgorod is INFERRED as owner/operator (it runs the regional programme and Morozov heads it; no source explicitly says 'owned by'); entity_lookup found no existing entity (new). Capacity, diameter, cost, ProposalYear (programme signed 2021, no source for this segment's proposal year) not found - left blank, no orphan refs. Route: none drawn; servitude documents on base.garant.ru name cadastral parcels for the Obkhod-Tonkino line only; Shakhunya line route research owed (RouteType blank). Tier high for existence/status/endpoints/length (one validated lineage + independent Prime report); owner medium.
